senses.gloss:
r. 1st cl. (घोटते)
1 To come back, to return.
2 To barter or exchange.
r. 6th cl. (घुटति)
1 To strike again or retaliate, to resist or oppose.
2 To prevent.
3 To protect or preserve.

m. (-टः)
The ancle.
E.
घुट to resist, and क affix; also घुटि, &c.

f. (-टिः-टी)
The ancle.
E.
घुट to resist, affix कि, and ङीप् may be added; also with कन् added घुटिका.

mf. (-कः-का)
The ancle, &c. see घुट and घुटि; also घुण्ट.
